title: If Gracie Is Eating
hook: She asks if Gracie is eating.
scene: Mom comes through on the radio, which she doesn't always. She asks if Gracie is eating. You say yes. She waits a second and does not ask about the other one, because you already told her and neither of you is doing that again today. She says the pass took more snow. You say you know. The window closes.

source.teaching_target: Mom asks if Gracie is eating and mentions the pass. She does not ask how the driving is going.

image_brief.subject: Ali standing outside in the lot, looking down, filling out a metal clipboard — paper facing her, only the blank brushed-steel back toward the camera
